They face each other at very close distance, bodies touching, in the posture of a brief handshake, greeting and quiet word, and then they turn together toward the stone entrance on the right and walk out of frame to the right side-by-side.

He returns to collect and acknowledge the official he had walked past. He had given precedence to royalty by going first to bow to the woman, leaving the waiting man unacknowledged. He comes back to repair that by greeting him face-to-face at close distance, and then to draw him with him off the carpet and into the building, so the carpet is left clear for the mayor with the chain and the royal party advancing behind them. The turn together and side-by-side walk to the entrance, after the head-to-head close stand, is what shows this is a fetching and escorting action, not merely passing by.
